# scout_apm

**Tag**: library

## 简介

Monitors Ruby apps and reports detailed metrics on performance to Scout.

- 主页: https://www.scoutapm.com

- 更新日志: https://github.com/scoutapp/scout_apm_ruby/blob/master/CHANGELOG.markdown
- RubyGems: https://rubygems.org/gems/scout_apm
